page.layout: One page of text, centred; title block at top, dedication, scripture quotation with verse text, woodcut vignette, imprint at foot. No margin notes. Right margin shows only a handwritten mark and a faint show-through, not transcribed.

main_text.l: Mihi verò pro minimo est quòd à vobis dí-
iudicer: aut ab humano iudicio : imò nec
meipsum dijudico. Nullius enim rei mihi
conscius sum: sed non per hoc iustifica-
tus sum: sed Dominus is est qui me diju-

page.notes: Woodcut vignette (a hand striking a burning or exploding object among clouds and rocks) between the scripture quotation and the imprint; not transcribed. Handwritten marks at top right and faint pencil numbers at lower centre are not printed text. The first line "APHORISTICA" has a large initial A.
